ops.title: End the orphaned drive child processes (ppid 1, over 10 min old)?
ops.body:
End them (Recommended)
Options: End them (Recommended) | Leave them
Notes: Answered by the owner through AskUserQuestion, 2026-11-15 ~19:47 PST. The question read: 59 drive child processes (pr check, pr wake, job prove, reload) orphaned to launchd by drive reinstalls (1.0.1298 to 1.0.1308), 10 min to 24 h old, holding 8.6 GB and driving most of a load of 252; end the ones orphaned over 10 minutes with SIGTERM, each verified by pid, ppid 1 and start time. The verified set is 43 pids: 1583 2673 5330 15407 16251 18939 24930 29097 31479 33046 33634 37676 39959 43469 46881 48082 51912 52686 61256 64521 65337 74926 74928 76657 76995 77063 77072 78448 79117 81329 81601 82741 82955 83155 83213 83256 83324 84780 84867 90247 95446 96640 96931
